addons.name: vanamaps
addons.title: VanaMaps
addons.author: Carver
addons.summary: Every zone's map as a window you can use. Drag it, zoom it, drop pins with notes, and share a pin in chat.
addons.description:
Every zone's map as an interactive window, sharp on any screen with the HD map pack and the game's own maps as fallback.

- Pan and zoom: drag to move the map, turn the wheel to zoom about the pointer, double-click to centre.
- You are on it: your arrow, your party and your target, on every floor.
- Pins: an icon, a colour, a title and a note, kept per character.
- Sharing: a pin goes to chat as a line anyone can read, and opens with one click for anyone with VanaMaps.
- Ways out: a signpost at each way into a neighbouring zone opens that zone's map.

Opens with M, or /vmap.

addons.name: auctionhouse-vanacore
addons.title: Auction House
addons.author: Carver
addons.summary: One modern window for browsing, buying, selling and keeping track of your sales.
addons.description:
Auction House replaces the game's auction window with one modern window for browsing, buying, selling and keeping track of your sales.

- Browse and buy: every category with live stock, price history, and what you can equip.
- Sell: your bags beside the listing form, with the going price filled in.
- Your sales: what sold, what is still up, and a bell when something sells.
- View anywhere, trade near a clerk.

Opens at any auction counter, or /ah.

addons.name: partyfinder-vanacore
addons.title: Party Finder
addons.author: Carver
addons.summary: Listings, join requests, Duty Roulette and Mission Help in one place.
addons.description:
Party Finder shows who is looking for a party and who is looking for members, and lets you ask to join with one click.

- Listings with the jobs each party still needs.
- Join requests the leader answers from a card.
- Duty Roulette and Mission Help.
- Thirteen themes, and a first-run tour.

Opens with Ctrl+G, or /pf.

addons.name: clawmark-vanacore
addons.title: Clawmark
addons.author: Carver
addons.summary: Raid-style target marks and waymarks, shared with your party and alliance.
addons.description:
Clawmark puts a mark over a target's head and a waymark on the ground, and everyone in your party or alliance with the addon sees the same ones.

- Eight marks, four lettered and four numbered waymarks.
- A small bar that stays out of the way.
- Marks follow the target; waymarks stay where you put them.

Opens with /clawmark.

addons.name: plates
addons.title: Plates
addons.author: VanaCore
addons.summary: Nameplates with health bars over players and monsters.
addons.description:
Plates draws a nameplate over each player and monster near you: a name, a health bar, and who has claimed it.

- Colours by claim and by party.
- Fades with distance.
- Hides in cutscenes.

addons.name: minparty
addons.title: MinParty
addons.author: VanaCore
addons.summary: A compact party list: names, jobs, health and magic in a third of the room.
addons.description:
MinParty replaces the party list with a compact one.

- Names, jobs, HP, MP and TP in one line each.
- The alliance in two more columns.
- Moves and scales with the mouse.

addons.name: zonegreeter
addons.title: Zone Greeter
addons.author: Seekey
addons.summary: The zone's name, the weather and the day, shown for a moment as you arrive.
addons.description:
Zone Greeter shows a short banner each time you change zones: the zone's name, the weather, and the day of the week.

Nothing to set up.
